classification: PREPARE-only design data; not an executable fixture or canonical test
qualification: Source predictions and required observations only. Internal-factory experiments require a separately approved, authenticated same-instance provider; neither imports nor execution are granted here.

commonPreparation.entry: one public run(guestSource, options) per identity, no CLI/Node oracle or source rewrite
commonPreparation.signal: one initially live invocation AbortSignal; E06 alone aborts it
commonPreparation.mark: ordinary synchronous host binding: accepts exactly one primitive, appends it to bounded event data, returns undefined; no guest reentry
commonPreparation.hostFs: controlled explicitly injected async VFS with only /work/a containing UTF8 AB, no host paths or ambient authority; writes denied
commonPreparation.hostPromise: one deferred native Promise per admitted read; allocated only after cleanup registration and admission; resolver/rejector retained by the controller
commonPreparation.intrinsicFactory: proposed host-supplied exact-engine createSandboxClosure from src/interp/values.ts; not a package-root export; no brand synthesis, guessing, private import, engine copy or modification
commonPreparation.intrinsicShapeData: createSandboxClosure({ name: 'readFileSync', call: (args) => checkedTrackedRead(args) }); deliberately omit async:true; checkedTrackedRead returns native Promise<guest string>, not SandboxPromise
commonPreparation.capsStatus: finite proposed experiment controls, not ratified NP1 product caps; deadlines/watchdogs are failure bounds, not correctness oracles or forced-preemption claims
capture: raw reason identity comparisons in trusted host
commonPreparation.noReadyCriterion: A missing planned admission/event within the finite observation cap is inconclusive/failure-to-observe, never a fabricated passing held-state observation. For a failed hold, release/reject the owned deferred work and drain it; do not keep waiting or add runs.

experiments.question: Do ordinary pure synchronous nested module callbacks return/throw synchronously?
experiments.guestSource: import fs from 'host'; mark(fs.pure(6)); try { fs.fail(); } catch (error) { mark(error.message); } mark('after');
schedule: Register cleanup, inject module and mark, start one run
No delayed host operation; await controlled run settlement
Drain owner and close
experiments.discriminates: Supported pure sync host calls are not evidence that async VFS is sync, and absence of builtin fs does not imply impossibility

experiments.question: Does an ordinary non-async host callback returning a Promise expose a guest promise rather than the eventual string?
experiments.guestSource: const text=fs.readFileSync('/work/a','utf8'); mark(text==='AB'); mark(typeof text); mark('after');

providerData.bindings.fs.readFileSync: ordinary non-async function returning the admitted deferred Promise; no async keyword and no branded intrinsic

schedule: Register cleanup, start run
At read admission hold resolver; observe up to32 checkpoints or until all three marks
Record whether engine settled while read remained pending; do not require settlement
Resolve read with AB exactly once
Drain read, engine and owner
experiments.unresolvedObservation: Exact outer run settlement timing is a discrimination question; no unhandled-rejection or general pending-work drain guarantee is inferred
experiments.discriminates: Changing host async syntax does not avoid executeHostCall/createHostCallPromise boxing

experiments.question: Can the unflagged internal intrinsic suspend an ordinary unawaited readFileSync call while preserving guest job ordering?
experiments.guestSource: Promise.resolve().then(()=>mark('job')); const text=fs.readFileSync('/work/a','utf8'); mark(text==='AB'); mark(text.length); mark('after');
schedule: Register cleanup, create intrinsic, start run
Hold at admitted read and observe up to32 checkpoints
Record no following guest marks and pending engine; record whether queued job ran
Resolve read with AB exactly once
Await engine, job and owner retirement
experiments.qualification: Predicted by invokeSandboxClosure's non-async native-Promise await plus retained job ownership, not newly measured behavior; failure requires revising feasibility

experiments.question: Does delayed rejection from the intrinsic throw at the ordinary call into its same try/catch?
experiments.guestSource: try { fs.readFileSync('/work/a','utf8'); mark('bad'); } catch (error) { mark(error==='DENIED'); } mark('after');

providerData.bindings.fs.readFileSync: same-instance unflagged branded intrinsic returning the admitted deferred Promise

schedule: Register cleanup and start run
Hold at read admission; observe no marks within32 checkpoints
Reject admitted read with the primitive string DENIED
Await engine and owner retirement
experiments.qualification: Primitive catch semantics are isolated from arbitrary object/control identity. This does not authorize converting root cancellation to an ordinary catchable filesystem error.

experiments.question: Which repeated-return and module cache identities survive ordinary copying versus intrinsic return?
experiments.guestSource: import first from 'cached'; import second from 'cached'; mark(first===second); const hostFirst=hostRequire('cached'); const hostSecond=hostRequire('cached'); mark(hostFirst===hostSecond); const guestFirst=require('cached'); const guestSecond=require('cached'); mark(guestFirst===guestSecond); guestFirst.value=2; mark(guestSecond.value);

providerData.modules.cached.default: one plain data record with value1
providerData.bindings.hostRequire: ordinary synchronous host function returning the same host record H={value:1} every call
providerData.bindings.require: same-instance unflagged intrinsic whose call returns one provider-owned validated guest-data record G={value:1}, without ordinary copyHostResultToSandbox; distinct from H and module default; enforce name cached only

schedule: Register cleanup and allocate bounded H/G/module input
Start one signal-wrapped run; no deferred operation
Capture all marks, retained object counts and mutation state
Drain owner; destroy invocation-local cache
experiments.unresolvedObservation: Whether G itself or a cancellation-wrapper copy receives the guest mutation is recorded, not used as a host-state identity claim. Different module aliases/namespaces and other invocations are not certified.

experiments.question: Can an external provider retain caller reason identity and hold public settlement until cooperative cleanup retires, even if engine cancellation settles earlier?

providerData.bindings.fs.readFileSync: same-instance unflagged intrinsic with one tracked cooperative read
providerData.publicEnvelope: PREPARE-only owner design: register idempotent cleanup before acquisition; retain caller provenance/R independently of engine result; await admitted read and held cleanup before propagating R

schedule: Register cleanup, start engine inside owner envelope
Hold read after admission
Abort root signal with the exact R object; close owner admission
Keep cooperative cleanup held for32 observation checkpoints; record raw engine pending/settled and error identity without forcing an outcome
Reject underlying held read with a distinct Error('late-host') to exercise late observation
Release cleanup exactly once
Await every tracked settlement and envelope rejection
experiments.qualification: No envelope is implemented here. Raw engine timing/error shape are discrimination questions. A failing target rejects the provider design; abort does not prove underlying work stopped.

experiments.question: Does explicit guest await correctly consume the ordinary host Promise while releasing the guest job queue?
experiments.guestSource: Promise.resolve().then(()=>mark('job')); const text=await fs.readFileSync('/work/a','utf8'); mark(text==='AB'); mark(text.length); mark('after');

providerData.bindings.fs.readFileSync: ordinary non-async host function returning the admitted deferred Promise, exactly the F02 route

schedule: Register cleanup and start run
Hold at read admission; observe up to32 checkpoints for job mark
Record pending engine and absence of text/after marks
Resolve read with AB exactly once
Await engine and owner retirement
experiments.qualification: This control uses explicit guest await and must never be reported as synchronous readFileSync compatibility. Scheduler observations remain unexecuted source predictions.
